book_name: 词栖 · 开始的 24 个词

words.tr: n. 焦点；v. 集中注意力
words.ex: Focus on one task at a time.
words.ex_cn: 一次专注于一项任务。
words.usage: focus on · 专注于

words.ex: Reading is a useful habit.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是个有益的习惯。
words.usage: develop a habit · 养成习惯

words.ex: The journey takes two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这趟旅程需要两小时。
words.usage: a long journey · 漫长的旅程

words.ex: Practice helps us improve.
words.ex_cn: 练习帮助我们进步。
words.usage: improve your skills · 提高技能

words.ex: Keep a balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 保持工作与休息的平衡。
words.usage: a balance between A and B · A与B之间的平衡

words.ex: We discovered a quiet place to read.
words.ex_cn: 我们发现了一个安静的阅读地点。
words.usage: discover a new idea · 发现新想法

words.ex: Be patient with yourself.
words.ex_cn: 对自己耐心一点。
words.usage: be patient with · 对……有耐心

words.ex: Every small effort matters.
words.ex_cn: 每一份微小的努力都有意义。
words.usage: make an effort · 作出努力

words.ex: Stay curious about the world.
words.ex_cn: 保持对世界的好奇。
words.usage: be curious about · 对……好奇

words.ex: She feels confident about the test.
words.ex_cn: 她对这次考试很有信心。
words.usage: be confident about · 对……有信心

words.ex: Small steps help us achieve our goals.
words.ex_cn: 小小的步伐帮助我们实现目标。
words.usage: achieve a goal · 实现目标

words.ex: Learning something new is a challenge.
words.ex_cn: 学习新事物是一项挑战。
words.usage: face a challenge · 面对挑战

words.ex: Remember to take a short break.
words.ex_cn: 记得短暂休息一下。
words.usage: remember to do · 记得去做

words.ex: Friends support each other.
words.ex_cn: 朋友互相支持。
words.usage: support each other · 互相支持

words.ex: A gentle wind moves the leaves.
words.ex_cn: 轻风吹动树叶。
words.usage: a gentle reminder · 温和的提醒

words.ex: You are making progress every day.
words.ex_cn: 你每天都在进步。
words.usage: make progress · 取得进步

words.ex: A quiet environment helps me study.
words.ex_cn: 安静的环境帮助我学习。
words.usage: protect the environment · 保护环境

words.ex: Every day is an opportunity to learn.
words.ex_cn: 每天都是学习的机会。
words.usage: take an opportunity · 把握机会

words.ex: Make a decision after you have the facts.
words.ex_cn: 了解事实后再作决定。
words.usage: make a decision · 作决定

words.ex: The book is available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆里可以借到这本书。
words.usage: be available to · 可供……使用

words.ex: Short breaks can reduce stress.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息可以减轻压力。
words.usage: reduce stress · 减轻压力

words.ex: Compare your progress with last week.
words.ex_cn: 把你的进度与上周比较一下。
words.usage: compare A with B · 把A与B比较

words.ex: What is the purpose of this exercise?
words.ex_cn: 这个练习的目的是什么？
words.usage: on purpose · 故意地

words.ex: Use reliable sources when you learn.
words.ex_cn: 学习时使用可靠的资料来源。
words.usage: a reliable source · 可靠的来源
